correctness.rationale: The Heisenberg derivation blocks D(v)=Av+f(v)z, Dz=lambda z obey A^T J+JA=lambda J. D²=0 gives lambda=0, A²=0,fA=0 in every characteristic. For symplectic skew-adjoint square-zero A, U=im A is isotropic, ker A=U^perp, r=dim U≤m; nondegenerate symmetric U*→U maps classify the A at fixed U, including characteristic two. Isotropic Grassmann count I_mr and nonsingular symmetric-form count S_r yield #A. For each A rank r, f vanishing on U has q^{2m−r} choices, of which q^r vanish on ker A and keep total D rank r; others increase rank by 1, except r=m where q^{2m−r}=q^r. This proves displayed polynomial, ranks 0..m, and dominant rank m by leading q-degree. Independently evaluated coefficients at (m,q)=(1,2),(2,2),(2,3),(3,2),(2,5), agreeing with RESULT; inspected direct finite matrix enumeration code but did not execute all exhaustive cases. Full characteristic-two congruence/stabilizer structure is a substantial input.
